title: The Detective
description: Somewhere under ~/golf/haystack/ there is a hidden file called .needle — find it and copy it to ~/golf/found.txt
setup: rm -rf ~/golf/haystack ~/golf/found.txt && mkdir -p ~/golf/haystack/a/b/c ~/golf/haystack/d/e ~/golf/haystack/f/g/h/i && echo 'You found the needle!' > ~/golf/haystack/f/g/h/i/.needle
hints: The find command can search for files by name
Combine find with cp, or use find -exec
